primary_rule.source: Scientific default adopted by Modeling Lead at this freeze; Foundation acceptance remains unresolved.
primary_rule.loss: mean absolute scaled error of ensemble mean
primary_rule.comparison: unrounded MASE strictly below every benchmark
primary_rule.lag: HLN horizon 4 at 90 days, comprising 3 autocovariance lags, from maximum actual origin overlap; no independent-origin or calibrated-power claim.
primary_rule.pass: point-better on all primary comparisons and every p_less < 0.05
primary_rule.fail: any primary point MASE at or above its benchmark
primary_rule.inconclusive: point-better but insufficient or undefined inference
primary_rule.inventory: Exactly 8 primary 90-day origins. Missing or duplicated required comparison rows produce INCONCLUSIVE; missing realized-data support fails execution.

origins: fit origin plus month starts with complete horizon support
fitting: Reconstruct released estimators once at day before exclusive fit cut, compare exact adopted fit and ordered draw identities before labels, then keep blocks/tables/draws immutable across origins. Any mismatch refuses; no tolerance, seed or runtime search.
state_clock: 23:59:59 UTC at each origin; accepted_at must be no later than that instant
daily_window: before exclusive score_until; exclude all Granite start day from fitting and Helicon partial day from daily score
event_window: Granite16:00UTC to Helicon15:00UTC for protected labels; exact maturity by target
missingness: fail on missing/incomplete/duplicate daily stocks; no silent date or comparator substitution
behaviour_table: frozen point renewal/return blocks and conditional duration tables; prior/history/persistence frozen before fit cut; separate from system ensemble verdict
unresolved: Foundation definition/acceptance of the signed correlation/population/window requirement; scientific default does not amend the contract.
Total bonded, staking ratio, contiguous contract path and active-pattern missing measurements remain unavailable under this selected scope.
Final-source independent review, actual matching development rehearsal and actual exact-fit preflight on the named runner.
Complete historical scientific-trial and specification-changing exposure reconciliation is not asserted; known history and unknowns are disclosed in development-record.json.
External registration commitment, substantive witness, remote/history checks, independent runner eligibility and PM final-gate handoff.

behaviour_targets.renewal_7d: Ended validator commitments with full7-day follow-up strictly before event end; same-node successor in[end,end+7days].
behaviour_targets.return_8_90d_given_no_7d_renewal: Full90-day follow-up, conditional on no observed7-day renewal; daily frozen hazard survival over days8through90.
behaviour_targets.next_duration_days: First nonoverlapping successor started before event end; exact scheduled duration rounded to nearest whole day, minimum1.
behaviour_targets.leave_365d: Deferred because this evaluation window does not mature365-day labels.
behaviour_targets.baselines: Prior, node history and node persistence from source eligible by the frozen fit cut. Renewal/return baseline cohorts use365pre-fit days.
behaviour_targets.distribution: Frozen point coefficients and empirical duration tables, separate from200-draw system scores.

pre_outcome_overlap_check.algorithm: one plus maximum later origins strictly inside forecast window
pre_outcome_overlap_check.power_reassessment: No calibrated power or minimum detectable effect is claimed for these 8 overlapping primary origins. Earlier 11.1% and 12.4% figures apply to another design and are not transferred. Low power can yield INCONCLUSIVE; no threshold adaptation.

slice_projection.admission: accepted_at no later than frozen fit-origin23:59:59UTC
slice_projection.supply_counter: include only when the period started by fit cut; exclude future-start counters

frozen_fit.draw_order: Entire saved 200-row, 29-column table in original order, draw_seed 0. For batch seed b = 0..9 use rows 20*b through 20*b+19, preserving order. No sweep-bank subset, sorting or recentering.
frozen_fit.runtime_condition: Recorded producer environment is provenance, not a guarantee of future equality. Actual runner reconstruction must match exact fit and draw hashes before marker, and again before scoring labels.
frozen_fit.artifact_verification: Full 11-artifact SHA256 inventory verified separately during package review. Runtime guard checks exact fit and ordered draws; it does not open/authenticate a saved pickle or the artifact-manifest bytes.

frozen_fit_binding_status: ADOPTED distinct FIT-O2 object. Exact pre-marker and score-side guards remain required. No protected execution or historical identity follows from adoption.
